name: Halloween Time at the Disneyland Resort
summary: Halloween Time runs August 21–October 31, 2026, across both Disneyland Resort parks with regular admission and a same-day park reservation. Disney California Adventure décor and Monsters After Dark began August 18; Plaza de la Familia continues through November 2.
h1: Halloween Time at the Disneyland Resort: what changes, what it costs you, and when to go
title: Halloween Time at the Disneyland Resort
description: Disneyland Halloween Time 2026: confirmed dates, ride overlays, Oogie Boogie Bash closures and what regular admission includes.

typicalWindow.hours: Seasonal décor is available during regular park hours. Guardians of the Galaxy – Monsters After Dark begins in the late afternoon; Halloween Screams is scheduled on select nights, with fireworks on select performances.

pricing.cheapestNights: Midweek dates in early and mid-September, which are also the quietest of the whole run
pricing.priciestNights: The last three weekends of the run, when date-based ticket pricing peaks and the resort runs at its highest crowd level outside the December holidays
notes: The overlay itself is included with valid park admission and a same-day reservation. There is no separate Halloween Time ticket and no upcharge for either ride takeover.

The range above is not an admission price. It is roughly what a seasonal food item costs. Other optional purchases, including guided tours if offered for your date, cost extra; Oogie Boogie Bash is a separate ticketed event.
Oogie Boogie Bash is a separate ticketed party at Disney California Adventure; treat trails, Villains Grove and Madame Leota’s street party are party offerings.
Ticket prices are date-based, so the same overlay costs more to see on an October Saturday than on a September Tuesday. That difference is the closest thing to a price for Halloween Time.
What else costs extra: Lightning Lane Multi Pass ran $30 to $45 per person per day at Disneyland Resort as of July 2026, and standard parking ran $35 to $40.

whatYouGet: Haunted Mansion Holiday at Disneyland Park - the Nightmare Before Christmas takeover, installed for the season after a multi-week closure and left up through the December holidays.
Guardians of the Galaxy – Monsters After Dark at Disney California Adventure, August 18–October 31, beginning in the late afternoon rather than after full darkness.
Haul-O-Ween in Cars Land, which is the strongest single piece of seasonal decoration at either resort, with holiday variants of Mater's and Luigi's attractions and a full repaint of the land.
Plaza de la Familia in Paradise Gardens Park at Disney California Adventure, August 21–November 2, with Coco-inspired performances, mariachi music and a memory wall.
Halloween Screams at Disneyland Park on select nights; fireworks accompany select performances, so check the entertainment calendar.
Seasonal decoration across both parks, including the Main Street pumpkin display and the Mickey jack-o-lantern at the Disneyland Park entrance.
Halloween-specific food across both parks and a large seasonal merchandise line.
Mickey’s Trick and Treat at the Disney Theater in Hollywood Land, which Disney says began August 18.
whatYouDont: The regular Haunted Mansion. The overlay is installed for roughly four months, from around September through the first week or two of January, so a fall or December trip means the standard version is simply unavailable. If that ride is a reason you are going to Disneyland Park, go in another season.

Short waits on the two attractions you came for. Haunted Mansion Holiday routinely posts the longest standby wait in Disneyland Park during the season, comfortably above what the standard version draws in June, and the evening Guardians variant spikes the moment it switches over.
A reliable Space Mountain overlay. The Halloween version of that ride has appeared in some seasons and been absent in others. Do not plan a trip around it and do not assume it from an old blog post.
Oogie Boogie Bash offerings such as themed treat trails, Villains Grove and Madame Leota’s 2026 street party. These require a separate event ticket.
Extra capacity. The resort does not add attractions for the season; it repaints two, decorates the rest, and then hosts a substantially larger crowd in the same footprint.

A full evening at Disney California Adventure on party nights. That park closes early to regular guests on Oogie Boogie Bash dates, which pushes everyone else into Disneyland Park and makes its evening noticeably busier.

verdict.short: Halloween Time needs valid admission and a same-day park reservation, but no separate event ticket. Haunted Mansion Holiday replaces the regular Mansion. September beats late October.
worthItIf: Anyone in your group likes The Nightmare Before Christmas. The Haunted Mansion takeover is the best thing either resort does with an existing attraction.
You are choosing between an early-autumn California trip and a spring one. September gives you the full overlay at close to the lowest crowd level of the year.
You want the seasonal atmosphere without paying for a party ticket you probably cannot buy anyway.
You are visiting both parks, since one takeover sits in each and a single-park day gets you half the season.
You have visited Disneyland Resort in a normal month before and want a version of it that looks different.
skipIf: The standard Haunted Mansion is on your must-ride list. It is out of service in its normal form for about a third of the year and this is that third.
Your dates are in the last two weeks of the run and crowds genuinely bother you. The final October weekends at Disneyland Park are among the busiest days of the year outside the December holidays.
You are expecting the Bash treat trails, villains or Madame Leota’s street party with regular admission. Those require a separate party ticket, and 2026 general admission is sold out.
Your trip is short and driven by ride count. The overlays add two attractions to your queue list, not two attractions to the park.
You are traveling with someone who finds the Haunted Mansion difficult. The seasonal version is louder and busier than the standard one, and the queue is longer.

strategy.heading: Ride Haunted Mansion Holiday first thing or last thing
body: The seasonal Haunted Mansion has a wait profile unlike the rest of Disneyland Park, and knowing its shape is worth an hour of your day. It opens shorter than most people expect, because the opening crowd walks straight past New Orleans Square toward Galaxy's Edge and Fantasyland. From roughly eleven in the morning it climbs and then stays high until the final hour.

That gives you exactly two good windows: the first 45 minutes of the day, or the last 60 minutes before close. Everything between is a queue measured in whole fractions of an hour, on a ride that most of the year is a walk-on-adjacent 20 minutes.

The overlay is worth riding more than once across a trip because it changes in one specific way each year: the gingerbread house in the ballroom is redesigned annually, and that is the detail repeat visitors go back for. It is also the reason the ride is worth doing even if you rode the seasonal version two years ago.

The permanent details of the attraction itself live on its own page and are not repeated here. What is seasonal is the timing: the changeover closes the ride for a stretch in late summer while the overlay is installed, and again in January while it comes out. If your dates land in either changeover, you get neither version.

strategy.heading: Plan for Monsters After Dark in late afternoon or evening
body: Guardians of the Galaxy – Monsters After Dark runs August 18 through October 31, 2026. Disney says the alternate mission begins in the late afternoon each day; do not describe it as an after-dark-only ride.
Check that day’s Disneyland app listing for the exact switchover time and current wait. The regular Mission: BREAKOUT! ride operates before the seasonal mission begins.
On an Oogie Boogie Bash date, regular DCA guests leave at 6:00 p.m. The event continues until 11:00 p.m. for guests with a Bash ticket.
If the seasonal mission is a priority, plan a DCA visit with enough late-afternoon time rather than assuming a morning visit will include it.

strategy.heading: When to go inside the window
body: The first three weeks are the entire value proposition. Late August and September weekdays give you the fully installed overlay at the lowest crowd level Halloween Time ever has, at the cheapest date-based ticket prices in the window, in the warmest weather of the Anaheim year.

The last two weekends before Halloween are the opposite on every one of those measures. A large share of that crowd is local annual pass holders on a day trip, which is why the pattern is so sharply weekend-weighted at this resort compared with Orlando.

If your dates are locked into late October, use the party nights rather than fighting them. Disney California Adventure closes early to regular guests on Oogie Boogie Bash dates. That is bad news for a Disney California Adventure evening and good news for the following morning, when a meaningful share of the local crowd is recovering from a party that ended at eleven.

One scheduling detail worth checking before you book: the seasonal fireworks at Disneyland Park run on select nights rather than nightly, and September midweek dates are the ones most likely to go without. If the fireworks matter, weight your visit toward a Friday or a weekend and accept the trade.

strategy.heading: The decorations that are actually worth walking to
body: Cars Land after dark is the best thing Halloween Time does that does not involve a queue. The whole land is repainted for the season, the two smaller attractions get their own overlays, and it reads far better under the neon at night than it does at two in the afternoon.

Plaza de la Familia, in Paradise Gardens Park, is the quietest good thing in either park during the season. It runs live music and a short stage show on a loop through the day, it has seating, and almost nobody plans for it - which is exactly why it is a reliable place to sit down at four in the afternoon when the rest of the park is full.

At Disneyland Park, the entrance and Main Street displays are the photograph everyone wants and are best done in the first 20 minutes after opening or in the last hour. The line for the Mickey pumpkin photograph in the middle of an October afternoon is longer than several rides.

In 2026, Disney California Adventure Halloween décor was ready August 18, while Disneyland Park, Downtown Disney and resort hotels were fully decorated August 21. The resort-wide Halloween Time season is August 21–October 31.

faqs.q: Is Halloween Time included with a regular Disneyland ticket?
faqs.a: The advertised in-park Halloween Time offerings are included with valid admission and a same-day park reservation; there is no separate Halloween Time ticket. Oogie Boogie Bash requires its own event ticket, and seasonal food, merchandise and optional extras cost more.

faqs.q: Can I ride the regular Haunted Mansion during Halloween Time?
faqs.a: No. The seasonal overlay is a physical installation, not a lighting change, and it stays in place from around September through the first week or two of January. There is no version of the season where both are available, and the ride closes entirely for a stretch at each changeover.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Halloween Time and Oogie Boogie Bash?
faqs.a: Halloween Time is the August 21–October 31 seasonal program across the resort, available with regular park admission and a same-day reservation. Oogie Boogie Bash is a separate ticketed DCA party on 33 select nights, featuring treat trails, Villains Grove and Madame Leota’s street party.

faqs.q: When is the least crowded time to see Halloween Time?
faqs.a: Weekdays in the first three weeks, which at this resort means late August and the first half of September. Crowd levels rise steadily through October and peak on the final two weekends, and the swing is driven by local annual pass holders rather than by tourists, which is why weekday-versus-weekend matters far more here than it does at Walt Disney World.

faqs.q: Does Space Mountain get a Halloween overlay at Disneyland?
faqs.a: Not reliably. The Halloween version of that ride has run in some seasons and been absent in others, and its return has not followed a pattern strong enough to plan around. Treat it as a bonus if it appears in the schedule for your dates and not as a reason to book them.

faqs.q: Do I need to visit both parks to see Halloween Time?
faqs.a: Yes, if you want both ride overlays, because one sits in each park. Disneyland Park holds the Haunted Mansion takeover and the seasonal fireworks; Disney California Adventure holds the evening Guardians variant, Haul-O-Ween in Cars Land, and Plaza de la Familia. A single-park day gets you roughly half the season.

faqs.q: Are this season's Halloween Time dates confirmed?
faqs.a: Yes. Disney confirms Halloween Time from August 21 through October 31, 2026. DCA Halloween décor and Guardians of the Galaxy – Monsters After Dark began August 18; Plaza de la Familia runs August 21–November 2. Check the daily calendar for entertainment times and party-day park hours.
